interpretation: The target OLED enumerated as 057e:201d in Copy to PC via USB mode and answered PTP GetDeviceInfo without opening a session. The observed firmware and serial prefix match the owner's manual confirmation. The DeviceInfo model string is generic and does not distinguish OLED from LCD.
limitations: PTP DeviceInfo is what the console reports; modified firmware could spoof it.
The model number HEG-001 and the no-modification history remain owner-reported; PTP does not establish either.
The observation does not prove integrity, boot state, exploitability, or CFW access.
This is one console and one observation, not a general OLED compatibility proof.
